messages:
toni (partnerships): Heads-up: SI partner (CloudWorks) needs our compliance pack for the joint managed offering. They asked for SOC2, external pentest (redacted ok), SBOM for deployed components, and a short signed attestation covering data residency. Deadline: 48h. Can @ash + @meera pick this up? Link they gave: https://cloudworks-partner.io/onboard :wave;
ash (security): I can run the checks. Quick clarify: SBOM format preference? SPDX or CycloneDX? Also will we provide full pentest or a vendor-signed summary?
meera (legal): Ill handle redaction/NDA. If CloudWorks will store our files in their tenant we need a data processing addendum. I can draft that.
rafa (solutions): We have SOC2 PDF in vault and an SBOM generator for our helm charts. I can produce CycloneDX and attach. Also will collect the list of hostnames for the in-scope inventory.
s3-bot: New bucket ready: s3://partners/cloudworks-evidence-1782345678. Use `/grant partners/cloudworks-evidence-1782345678 ash@redwood.com meera@redwood.com rafa@redwood.com toni@redwood.com` to grant access.
ash (security): Thanks. Toni  ask CloudWorks if SPDX is required; many reviewers accept CycloneDX. For pentest: ask vendor permission for redacted upload; if they decline provide `pentest_attestation_signed.pdf` + remediation tracker.
toni (partnerships): CloudWorks replied: CycloneDX is preferred but SPDX acceptable. They will accept a signed attestation if full report can't be shared. They also requested an emergency security contact phone number.
meera (legal): Drafting DPA addendum and vendor NDA now. Also will redact any customer-identifying data from pentest. Please tag me when the redacted file is in the bucket.
rafa (solutions): Upload plan: `soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf`, `pentest_external_2025_redacted.pdf` (or attestation), `sbom_cyclonedx_2025.xml`, `in_scope_hosts.csv`, `remediation_tracker.csv`, `attestation_data_residency.pdf`. Will follow filename rules (lowercase, underscores). ETA 6h.
ash (security): I'll prepare `remediation_tracker.csv` with CVSS scores and current status. Also will add `pentest_attestation_signed.pdf` template in case vendor refuses raw upload.
toni (partnerships): Perfect. If you can get presigned links here Ill send to CloudWorks and confirm intake. Prefer not to ask for an extension. :thumbsup:
meera (legal): Sent preliminary NDA to the pen-test vendor and CloudWorks. If vendor needs more restrictions we can fallback to the attestation.
s3-bot: Access granted for ash@redwood.com and rafa@redwood.com. meera@redwood.com pending manual approval. Presigned URLs will expire in 7 days.
rafa (solutions): Uploaded SBOM (CycloneDX) and draft inventory. Links posted but only visible to granted users. Will post final presigned URLs after meera gets access.
ash (security): Reviewing SBOM for disallowed components and known CVEs. If any show up I'll add them to `remediation_tracker.csv` and include mitigation notes.
toni (partnerships): Thanks team. This thread is canonical for CloudWorks listing artifacts. Ill update CloudWorks when presigned links are ready and confirm emergency contact info. :rocket;
